svg.title: SLICES benchmark overview
svg.desc: Benchmark contract in four bands: fixed processed ICU datasets and task labels, fixed shared Transformer encoder, three varying SSL objectives with context baselines, and a fixed evaluation contract with two evaluation paths, four targets, and repeated seeds.
